item.title: Rallying Cry – November 12, 2026
item.description: A boy gains control over his Tourette’s tics with a new device, Meta brings back a vital page tracking femicide in Australia, Korean startups get a shot at global fame, and a Ukrainian freediver makes history with a record-breaking dive.
